_comment: Models under evaluation. `pi_model` is the harness model (provider/id, see swarm/harnesses/pi/models.template.json);
null = not reachable yet (skipped with a message). `sample`: `all` = the 48-item sample, `shared` = its 18 shared items.
`price`: USD per 1M tokens [input, cached input, output]; null = unknown (cost reported as tokens only).
`expressivity`: also back-translate (Gemini only, per the evaluation design).

models.note: stands in for Gemini 3.1 Pro, which the vertex proxy does not serve (it lists only gemini-flash, gemini-flash-high, gemini-3.5-flash; gemini-3.1-pro-preview is rejected). Same model as the weak Gemini at high reasoning effort: the Gemini pair contrasts effort, not model size.
